game.title: Prototype 2
game.blurb: Open-world science-fiction action game from Radical Entertainment (RAWG also lists Activision and Radical), published by Activision Blizzard, released 2012-04-24. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story Missions
chapters.summary: The missions named in the achievements, in order of unlock rate: MEET YOUR MAKER, RESURRECTION, meeting Father Guerra, NATURAL SELECTION, FALL FROM GRACE and LABOR OF LOVE, then finishing the game. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: //BLACKNET and Field Ops
chapters.summary: //BLACKNET operations, targets and dossiers, and the Field Ops teams.

chapters.title: Lairs, BlackBoxes and the Highest Point
chapters.summary: Destroying Lairs, finding every BlackBox and reaching the highest point in the world.

chapters.title: Powers, Mutations and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Prototype Powers, Mutations in each category, upgrades through Consumes and fully upgrading Heller.

chapters.title: Vehicles, Helicopters and Movement
chapters.summary: Hijacking and weaponizing tanks and APCs, taking on helicopters, and long runs, glides and air time.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Consumes, Brawlers, Black Hole, Hammerfist, Bio-Bomb, Shield, stealth consumes, Strike Teams and alerts.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3226); RAWG also has unrelated entries named "Prototype-2", "Prototype 2: You" and "Prototype 2 - Maria". The Steam store list has one matching app, 115320 ("Prototype 2"); its schema is named "ValveTestApp115320" (a placeholder name). StrategyWiki has no page under "Prototype 2" or "Prototype II". prototype.fandom.com answers the API under "Prototype 2" with about 37 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 43 Steam achievements is hidden. The story order is our own reading of the unlock rates (82.3% for MEET YOUR MAKER down to 36.8% for finishing the game); the achievements do not number the missions. "Strike, You're Out." (destroy a Strike Team quickly) sits in combat because the data does not tie Strike Teams to Field Ops. "Anger Management" (destroy vehicles with a Finisher) and "Sic 'em!" (helicopters with Pack Leader) sit with vehicles.
